blocks.title: Vernalisation
blocks.text: Do-sala (biennial) aur kaseer-sala (perennial) podon ko kam darja-hararat ka samna kara kar phool ki tehreek di jati hai; yehi vernalisation hai. Kam darja-hararat ka muharrik pakke tane ke shoot ke sire (apex) ya beej ke embryo se liya jata hai, patton se nahin jaisa photoperiodism mein.

Kuch podon ke liye vernalisation lazmi zaroorat hai; doosron mein yeh phool lane mein sirf madad karti hai. Kam darja-hararat (thandak, chilling) ke ilaj ki muddat chaar din se teen mahine tak mukhtalif hai, aur qareeb 4 degree Celsius ka darja-hararat bohat moassar hai. Yeh ek hormone, vernalin, ki paidawar ko tehreek deta hai jo vernalisation lata hai.

Photoperiodism aur vernalisation podon ke afzaishi (reproductive) rawaiye ko un ke mahol ke saath ham-aahang karti hain, saal ke mawafiq waqton par afzaish yaqeeni banati hain. Yeh bhi yaqeeni banati hain ke ek nasl (species) ke pode ek hi waqt phool dein, jo cross-pollination aur yun jeneti tanawwo (genetic variability) ko barhawa deta hai.

blocks.caption: Vernalisation banam photoperiodism
rows: Kam darja-hararat, qareeb 4 degree Celsius chaar din se teen mahine tak
Pakke tane ka shoot apex, ya beej ka embryo
Mawafiq mausamon mein phool; cross-pollination ke liye ek saath phool

blocks.prompt: Sardiyon ki gandum bahar mein boi jaye to ugti hai magar phool nahin deti, jab ke wohi gandum khizan mein boi jaye to agli garmiyon mein phool deti hai. Samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Sardiyon ki gandum ko vernalisation chahiye: us ke shoot apex ya embryo ko vernalin banane aur phool dene ke qabil hone ke liye qareeb 4 degree Celsius ki thand ka daur chahiye. Khizan ki bowai use sardiyon ki thand deti hai; bahar ki bowai nahin, to woh nabati (vegetative) rehti hai.

items: Vernalisation thand (qareeb 4 degree Celsius, chaar din se teen mahine) se biennials aur perennials mein phool lana hai, jo shoot apex ya beej ke embryo se li jati hai, hormone vernalin ke zariye; kuch podon mein lazmi aur doosron mein madadgar.
Photoperiodism ke saath yeh afzaish ko mawafiq mausamon se milati aur cross-pollination aur genetic variability ke liye ek nasl mein phool ko ek waqt karti hai.
